name: @corbits-builder/coder-plugin
description: Builds the app the first time, and changes the app the project has, built here or imported.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The app needs building for the first time, or the person asks for a change to the app the project has.
builder.unless: The person is unsure what they want and a screen would let them choose, or they want only a mockup.

build.when: The project has no app yet: built from its requirements, build plan and design when they are filed, or from the person's instruction alone when they want it built now.
build.unless: The project already has an app; a change to it is coder change.

change.when: The person asks for a change to the app the project already has, built here or imported: a fix, an addition or a correction.
change.unless: The project has no app yet, or the person is unsure what they want and a screen would let them choose.

examples: go ahead and build the app

facts.app_exists: the project has an app, built or imported

stack.language.about: The programming language the app is written in, such as TypeScript.
